title: AcDs DataStorage move callback for the in-tree converter
scope: Avoid the in-tree converter's deep copy when retaining a completed parsed DataStorage section
Preserve the existing const-reference callback behavior for other consumers
Validate move and legacy callback routes with a focused adapter control

implementation.behavior: After successful DWG entity/object processing, libdwgr offers completed DataStorage sections by rvalue callback. The non-pure default forwards to the existing const-reference virtual. The in-tree dx_iface moves into dx_data storage; the existing const-reference adapter path remains a copy.
implementation.copyAvoided: One deep copy of the full DRW_DataStorageSection during in-tree adapter staging, including section-owned record payload vectors.
notBounded: copies made by arbitrary consumer callbacks
implementation.lifetimeBasis: The move callback runs after readDwgObjects completes, after section data has been used for entity linking and parsing.

workingTree.reasonNotCommitted: The shared worktree is broadly dirty with user-owned changes; the slice was kept isolated and uncommitted.
